summary: Devon Energy Corporation filed an 8-K to report the completion of exchange offers for outstanding Coterra Energy Inc. notes. Holders tendered various series of senior notes totaling $2.946 billion in principal; after settlement, $303.6 million remained outstanding. The exchange was for new Devon notes plus cash, conducted under a private offering memorandum. The filing also notes a third supplemental indenture. This is a routine debt refinancing/liability management transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms are disclosed as a merger or tender offer for equity securities.
